notes.title: Small update 1.01
notes.content:
- Changes log:
[list]
[*] Add collision wall to prevent player from going outside the map and get stuck.
[*] Add escape button to indicate the escape zone
[*] In the final battle, the AI will know all player unit's location, thus making the battle quicker. 
[*] Add button to hide unit panel during combat.
[/list]

- Thank you for playing the game!
